verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in conversational AI assistant, Repository Agent, that can browse and search files, read and modify them, commit, pull and push. That lets users hand repository tasks to an assistant inside the app, and AI commit-message suggestions add to it. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent (model choice, approval/review of changes, scope limits) and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well delegation works in practice.
